scope.market_definition: The data center systems market encompasses the physical and logical infrastructure used to build and operate data centers, including servers, storage systems, networking equipment, power and cooling systems, and the software and services that manage them. Participants include hardware manufacturers, component suppliers, system integrators, facility designers, and service providers. The market is global, covering enterprise, cloud, colocation, and edge data centers.
